name: France
description: France is famous for its wine, cuisine, fashion, and landmarks like the Eiffel Tower and the Louvre Museum.

name: Japan
description: Japan blends ancient traditions with modern life, known for cherry blossoms, sushi, and Mount Fuji.

name: Brazil
description: Brazil is known for its vibrant culture, the Amazon rainforest, and the iconic Christ the Redeemer statue.

name: Australia
description: Australia features stunning natural wonders like the Great Barrier Reef, unique wildlife, and modern cities.

name: Italy
description: Italy is renowned for its historic cities, art, architecture, and world-class food and wine.

name: Greece
description: Greece is known for its ancient ruins, whitewashed buildings, and beautiful Mediterranean beaches.

name: Thailand
description: Thailand offers tropical beaches, ornate temples, and vibrant street life.

name: Switzerland
description: Switzerland is known for its alpine scenery, luxury watches, and delicious chocolate.
